model.model: 3D inextensible unshearable Kirchhoff strain Ritz; exact SO(3) frame updates and midpoint centerline embedding
model.configuration: four Legendre curvature coefficients in each of two bending axes and torsion by default; all are dynamical
model.mass: configuration dependent; includes translational and rotary inertia from embedding Jacobians
model.KAM_status: Standard nonresonant elliptic KAM is not certified; circular isotropic rod with axial bias has paired bending frequencies.
model.relation_to_full_model: Shares material, distal magnet and field interface with the Cosserat model; shear/stretch omitted in this analytical ROM; modal truncation and fluid/contact closure errors are not yet bounded.
model.input: 12 total coil currents in A; no separate 8-field increment input or extra ideal bias
model.drag: synthetic smooth gamma*P; not a blood/contact closure
model.derivatives: double-precision automatic differentiation through full variable-mass SO(3) geometry
model.magnetism: Full circular-coil Biot-Savart energy; no additional ideal bias

coil_config.status: Engineering geometry and ratings; unbuilt and uncalibrated air-core coil benchmark

model.bias_initialization: Pre-energized fixed local axial-bias fit; not a zero-current startup
model.feedback_derivative: Hamiltonian partial z derivative first; compose i(z) afterwards; total field Jacobian contains Di/Dz
model.magnetic_domain: Away from ideal circular wires; physical_samples evaluates actual magnet quadrature points only
model.constraints: Smooth feedback not automatically bounded; coil_control handles explicit constrained current ramps.
model.input_at_execution: SI increment above axial bias: Bx,By,Bz,Gxx,Gyy,Gxy,Gxz,Gyz

same_field_protocol: Each branch and all methods in it share one full-coil/variable-mass field. Each branch has its own DOP853 references.
